title: Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins, Shemar Stewart listed as full participants on Wednesday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins, Shemar Stewart listed as full participants on Wednesday
sources.description: While Bengals head coach Zac Taylor told reporters on Wednesday that defensive end Shemar Stewart was more uncertain to play in Sunday's season opener than receivers Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins, the injury report indicates more optimism.
